نتنافع (form VI)
# نَتَنَافَعُ (natanāfaʕu) /na.ta.naː.fa.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَافَعَ (tanāfaʕa)
# نَتَنَافَعَ (natanāfaʕa) /na.ta.naː.fa.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَافَعَ (tanāfaʕa)
# نَتَنَافَعْ (natanāfaʕ) /na.ta.naː.faʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَافَعَ (tanāfaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
